videos.title: A "Perfect Storm" For Markets Lies Ahead Should Japan Repatriate Its US Assets | Lyn Alden
videos.description:
WORRIED ABOUT THE MARKET? SCHEDULE YOUR FREE PORTFOLIO REVIEW with Thoughtful Money's endorsed financial advisors at https://www.thoughtfulmoney.com

Japan poses a "Godzilla" risk to US markets.

So thinks Lyn Alden, due to tremendous amount of US assets held by Japanese households and corporations, and the growing risk that those assets may start to be repatriated in mass.

And this could happen as the AI trade starts to run out of steam, hitting US markets with a one-two punch that Lyn calls a "perfect storm".

For all the details as well as the timing when Lyn thinks this will start to matter, watch this video.
